info.title: API.SH: Formula 1
info.description: The Formula 1 API from API.SH: public Formula 1 data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

Lap-by-lap position and lap time of every driver in a race (records from 1996), optionally one lap or one driver. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

get.description:
The latest news from formula1.com, newest first: headline, summary, type (news, report, feature, live blog, video, podcast), link, last update, image with caption and size, exclusive and members-only flags. 16 items a page, with the total count. Headlines, summaries and links only, not full articles. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/f1-news

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: What to list (default all).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-500). Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Qualifying classification with each driver's Q1, Q2 and Q3 lap times, constructor and car number (complete from 2003). With any of driver_id, constructor_id, circuit_id, status_id or position, returns matching classification rows across races instead (all seasons unless season/round are given): `applied_filters`, `total`, `count`, `next_offset` and `races`, each with its matching `results`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/f1-qualifying

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/f1-results

The drivers' or constructors' championship table after each round of a season: position, points and wins of every driver (with their teams) or team, round by round. Filter to one driver or team to follow a title race.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

get.description:
Finishing status codes (Finished, +1 Lap, Engine, Collision, Retired, Disqualified ...) with how many times each occurred: across all history, in a season, in one race, or for a driver or team. Use a `status_id` with /f1/v1/results to list those results. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/f1-status

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
